title: 第一章    轮回之难
content_zh:
望着这乌云密布的天空，狂风大作，宛如末日般的世界，王琼心里有些压抑：看来要出大事了，不知道等会儿会出现怎样的情况，看来我只能走一步算一步了！

    这已是第九世轮回了，还有最后一世轮回，我就可以突破最后的禁锢，成就宇宙的巅峰，唯有这样黑暗宇宙之主才不会对我光明宇宙动手！这样我就可以控制光明和黑暗两个主宇宙的平衡，就不再有血腥的杀戮了，九世轮回了，这会儿可千万不要在这节骨眼上出现任何差错啊。坐在教室里的王琼，思绪飞出教室……

    霎时闪电大作，狂风吹打，“琼霄，我知道你在这里，出来吧，堂堂光明宇宙之主也会躲起来，”顿时操场中出现了一群身穿战甲的人，“琼霄。我黑暗宇宙来寻你了，难道你不亲自出来迎接一下么？莫非要我请你出来？再不出来我可要开杀戒了，”身穿暗黑色战甲的人阴沉的声音传遍了整个校园。

    “放肆，这里没有你要找的人，速速离开！”四个女生突然出现在一群神秘人面前。

    “你们是谁，我暗黑宇宙做事，还从没有人敢阻拦，更何况小小的地球人”。身穿黑色战甲的人阴沉的轻蔑道。

    突然出现的四位女生是学校的四位女神级别的人物，她们是薛云，林丽丹，王秀儿，王倩。“我们是谁你不用管，从哪来回哪去，这里没有你们要找的人，赶紧离开，不要影响学校的正常秩序！”薛云嗔怒道。

    “哈哈，这种低级的位面，我们黑暗宇宙只会清除，不能修行的位面，不需要存在，”这名身穿黑色战甲的中年人是黑暗宇宙十大战将中魔龙战将的座前将军中排名第十的将军黑龙。身穿黑色战甲的他显得无比凶残！

    “动手，杀了这群蝼蚁，毁灭这个星球，听说光明宇宙之主原本就是这个位面的人，哈哈，杀，一个不留，”黑龙下着命令。

    “是！杀！”黑龙身边的士兵吼道。

    “姐妹们，他们要破坏我们的星球，我们绝不能让他们得逞，开始战斗，”薛云道。

    在教室里的学生看到这种情况，又害怕又惊奇，他们没想到他们眼中的四位女神居然会那么强大！

    操场上剑气涌动，所到之处一片狼藉，黑龙看着交战双方，他万万没有想到，这个小小的位面还有如此厉害的人。这四个人的力量自己达到了神级的力量，他很惊讶，他怎么也想不通，这个不能修行的位面，怎么会有如此人物出现，而且是几个人同时出现。

    “唉！这些傻瓜，她们怎么不好好待在宇宙之巅，为何要下界轮回呢？”王琼叹息道。

    一道剑气击中一个下级士兵，突然士兵瞬间消失，“这是，这是，琼霄的女人才会的招式，怎么可能，她们不应该在下界啊，”黑龙惊恐，他看到的正是从薛云手中使出的剑招—天女散花。
content_en:
Looking at the sky covered with dark clouds, strong winds, and a doomsday-like world, Wang Qiong felt a little depressed: It seems that something big is going to happen. I don’t know what will happen later. It seems that I can only take one step at a time!

    This is already my ninth reincarnation, and there is still one last reincarnation left. I can break through the final confinement and reach the pinnacle of the universe. Only in this way will the Lord of the Dark Universe not attack my Light Universe! In this way, I can control the balance of the two main universes of light and darkness, and there will be no more bloody killings. Nine reincarnations will happen. I must not make any mistakes at this juncture. Sitting in the classroom, Wang Qiong's thoughts flew out of the classroom...

    Suddenly lightning struck and the wind blew, "Qiong Xiao, I know you are here, come out, the Lord of the bright universe will also be hiding." Suddenly a group of people wearing armor appeared in the playground, "Qiong Xiao. I, the Dark Universe, are here to look for you. Don't you come out to greet me in person? Do you want me to invite you out? If you don't come out, I will kill you." The gloomy voice of the man in dark armor spread throughout the campus.

    "Be bold, there is no one you are looking for here, leave quickly!" Four girls suddenly appeared in front of a group of mysterious people.

    "Who are you? No one dares to stop me from doing what I do in the dark universe, let alone the little earthlings." The man in black armor said with gloomy contempt.

    The four girls who suddenly appeared were the four goddess-level figures in the school. They were Xue Yun, Lin Lidan, Wang Xiuer, and Wang Qian. "You don't have to worry about who we are or where we are coming from. There is no one you are looking for here. Leave quickly and don't affect the normal order of the school!" Xue Yun said angrily.

    "Haha, our dark universe will only clear out such low-level planes. Planes that cannot be cultivated do not need to exist." This middle-aged man wearing black armor is the tenth general Black Dragon among the top ten generals in the dark universe. Wearing black armor, he looked extremely ferocious!

    "Get started, kill these ants and destroy this planet. I heard that the Lord of the Bright Universe was originally from this plane. Haha, kill no one," the black dragon ordered.

    "Yes! Kill!" the soldiers around Black Dragon roared.

    "Sisters, they want to destroy our planet, we must not let them succeed and start fighting," Xue Yun said.

    The students in the classroom were scared and surprised when they saw this situation. They did not expect that the four goddesses in their eyes would be so powerful!

    The sword energy surged on the playground, and everything was in chaos. Black Dragon looked at the two warring parties. He never thought that there were such powerful people in this small plane. The power of these four people reached god-level power. He was surprised. He could not figure out how such a person could appear in this plane where cultivation was impossible, and several people appeared at the same time.

    "Alas! These fools, why don't they stay at the top of the universe? Why do they have to reincarnate in the lower world?" Wang Qiong sighed.

    A ray of sword energy hit a lower-level soldier, and suddenly the soldier disappeared in an instant, "This, this is a move that only the women of Qiongxiao can do. How is it possible? They shouldn't be in the lower realm." Black Dragon was horrified. What he saw was the sword move used by Xue Yun - Tiannu Sanhua.
